thread:
noah: Starting follow-up thread for the short routing/TLS surge yesterday. Goal: assign owners, short ETAs, and make sure alerts/tests are in place.

irene: ack. quick recap?

noah: tl;dr: route-update writes intermittently failed (500) during a control-plane deploy. Clients fell back to cached resolver entries with mixed region priorities. Combined with an LB change that lowered stickiness, we saw cross-region retries, TLS handshake spikes, and duplicate flows.

omar: primary control-plane fix is DB contention + missing server-side circuit-breaker. i'll take circuit-breaker + retry-with-jitter. ETA: 48h to land, 72h to roll. PR WIP: github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/4610

tessa: i'll own LB guardrails: per-route cross-region cap + quick rollback tag. ETA: canary config in 24h, rollback doc in 36h. PR: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/2019

kia: telemetry and alerts. adding two alerts: (1) route-update-5xx-rate > 0.3% over 5m -> Pager, (2) cross_region_retry_ratio > 7% over 3m -> SRE. ETA: 2h. dashboard: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/2791230000

noah: test coverage & replay: create synthetic that simulates 500 then resolver fallback + mixed TTLs. tessa/omar will provide traces. kia schedule replay 48h after PR merges, run 72h.

omar: uploaded traces to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/2791230000/traces.tar.gz

tessa: sample LB snippet for canary:
```json
{"cross_region_burst_limit":40,"health_gate":true,"rollback_tag":"rb-2791230000"}
```

kia: syn job scheduled by @sre-bot once PRs are merged.

sre-bot: Scheduled: one-off "routing-tls-sim" to run after merges. Owners: omar, tessa, kia.

irene: registrar follow-up: some registrars ignore sub-minute TTLs; i'll open ticket and request explicit cache-invalidate API. ETA: ticket + contact info by EOD.

noah: Action items (short):
1) omar  circuit-breaker + jittered retries (48h -> patch, 72h -> rollout)
2) tessa  LB canary + rollback tag + doc (24-36h)
3) kia  telemetry + alerts + dashboard (2h)
4) irene  registrar ticket + edge TTL alignment (EOD)
5) team  syn replay (start 48h after merges, run 72h)

omar: small log snippet from incident:
[2027-08-10T11:03:12Z] route-update: write failed 500 -> client fallback -> resolver used old region list
[2027-08-10T11:03:12Z] lb: duplicate flows dropped=560

tessa: i'll enable canary in us-west after kia confirms alerts.

kia: created panels and alerts. link above. will post Alert IDs when created.

irene: registrar ticket RG-12240 opened, added edge owners.

oah: we'll do daily check-ins in this thread for 3 business days and a wrap sync in 5 days at 15:00 UTC. please post PR/merge links here so I can update postmortem follow-up doc.
